name: cosmetic-structural-sweep
brief: Clear the 11 Cosmetic-and-structural backlog items and 3 Ungrouped test-guard items (C1-C11, U1-U3), each re-measured against main e2e81e1. Main side: move an orphaned docblock (C1), merge two re-exports (C3), and add displayPath to BeachcomberPreviewRefusal so a refusal names its entry (C5). Renderer: route the select-all label through copy.ts (C4) and render the refusal's path; collapse Helm's three-valued lastAction latch to a boolean and test its untested release sites (C2); move lane hover onto the full swimlane, give a hovered selected Matriarch the --oc-bg-selected surface, and add flex: none to the status dot (C6-C8); move useDialogFocus to shell/ and adopt it in both always-mounted Pod dialogs, adding Tab trap and focus restore (C11). Tests: narrow the LaneRow no-clock guard (C9), make the retired-id scan quote-delimited (U1), relax the PodBar border-width predicate to multi-value longhands (U2), and delete the migration-1 byte-identity test that migration-frozen subsumes (C10), which makes U3 moot. Seven work tasks and a typecheck-plus-full-suite tail.
